title: Blog post front matter
description: The YAML front matter of one post in content/blog/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md (#1702). The body below the front matter is Markdown. site/src/lib/blog.mjs checks these rules at build time. Plain-language guide: content/blog/README.md.

date.description: The day the post went up. Must match the date in the file name.

summary.description: Two or three sentences, shown as "In short" at the top of the post and in the list.

pages.description: Site paths the post points to. The first is named in the note that shows after 90 days.

corrections.description: Dated notes about fixes. Each shows at the top of the post, and the post is listed on /corrections/.
